verdict.rationale: Vanta has a documented public developer platform. It includes a Manage Vanta API quickstart with token auth and listing of documents, policies and evidence. There are also API reference pages for tests and audits, task guides for assigning control owners and attaching evidence, webhooks with Svix signatures, and type-safe SDKs generated from an OpenAPI spec. Machine-readable llms.txt and .md doc variants both returned HTTP 200 on probes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API, and a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (probes of standard paths returned 404).
